messages:
Anna (product): Quick heads-up — ACME wants a private pilot the week of Apr 18. Need cross-team alignment on runtime/infra/security gating. Who owns canary capacity?
Kai (eng-runtime): I can own runtime config and rollout logic. Need model quant profile and KV cache plan. How many qps are we sizing for?
Sam (solutions): Customer expects 50 qps steady and bursts to 200 qps for short windows (5–10s). SLA ask is 99.9 with p95 < 250ms.
Dave (infra): For private pilot we should reserve 2 nodes and a small burst pool. Also need disk encryption certs and a network peering plan.
Maria (security): We'll require HSM integration for key material and a baseline penetration checklist before full install. ETA ~3 weeks for certs + controls.
Anna (product): Timeline constraint: contract says pilot start Apr 18, so ~3 weeks from now. What are the tradeoffs if security/infra can't finish?
Nora (eng-sre): Can we start with a very small canary (5%) on dedicated nodes and fallback to hosted for the rest? Also need a clear runbook for rollback + alerts.
Kai (eng-runtime): 5% canary is fine. I'll add automatic fallback to a compatible smaller model variant. Draft rollout config:```
rollout:
  canary_pct: 5
  fallback: rtx-small-v2
  metrics: [latency_p95, error_rate]
```
Dave (infra): Infra needs CIDR from ACME + VPN credentials to set up peering. Sam — can you coordinate with the customer? I can spin up staging nodes by Apr 4 if we get network details.
Sam (solutions): On it. Pinged ACME for CIDR and VPN today. Will push for the HSM MOU too. @Dave expect reply by EOD tomorrow.
Maria (security): For the pilot we might accept a signed attestation instead of a full pen-test if we lock retention to 24h and restrict logs. Is that acceptable commercially?
Anna (product): Contract team says attestation is ok for pilot with those retention limits. Can security sign off on attestation plus technical controls?
Maria (security): Yes, with conditions: E2E encryption in transit + at-rest, keys in customer-managed HSM, and audit logging to customer-managed S3 with strict ACLs.
Nora (eng-sre): Runbook note: If latency spikes above 300ms for >5m, auto-scale and pause canary, open incident channel. ops-bot should create that channel automatically.
ops-bot: [deploy-bot] created channel #release-orion-pilot-177777. Auto-notify on scale events and canary pauses.
Dave (infra): Action items: infra to provision nodes by Apr 4, get CIDR/VPN by Apr 1, coordinate certs with Maria. I'll create an infra checklist and link it here.
Kai (eng-runtime): I'll prepare runtime config, quantization recommendations, and KV cache sizing by Mar 30. I need a 1h sample workload trace from ACME (token distribution + prompt patterns).
Sam (solutions): I'll request the trace and CIDR from ACME today and push the HSM MOU signature.
Anna (product): Great. Treat this as high priority on the roadmap. I'll create JIRAs for infra/runtime/security action items and tag owners. Can we reconvene Fri 10am for a gating review?
Maria (security): Friday 10am works for security.
Nora (eng-sre): Works for SRE as well.
Kai (eng-runtime): Confirmed.
Dave (infra): Confirmed.
Sam (solutions): Confirmed.
Anna (product): Thanks all :thumbsup:
__notes: thread created for cross-team gating and sequencing for a customer private pilot; messages are short, Slack-style.
